author: Nintendo of America
description:
Tales of ARISE - Beyond the Dawn Edition is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on May 22, 2026! 

In Tales of ARISE, players will follow the adventures of Alphen and Shionne as they join forces to free the planet Dahna from 300 years of oppression under Rena. Explore vast regions, battle powerful enemies in fast-paced action combat, and uncover the truth that binds their worlds together. Beyond the Dawn continues the adventures of Alphen and Shionne with a new story set after the main game, introducing additional characters and new fields to explore.

description:
TOKYO SCRAMBLE is available now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/tokyo-scramble-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

In this survival puzzle-action game set deep underground, every step forward is a test of strategy, courage, and instinct. 

When Anne awakens after an accident, she finds herself in a network of subterranean caverns overrun by Zino—mysterious creatures that resemble dinosaurs. Left stranded in this hostile environment where only the strong survive, Anne's only hope is to fight her way toward the faint glow of the distant surface that guides her. 

Does she have what it takes to reach the light again?

author: Nintendo of America
description:
Overwatch Season 1: Conquest begins today on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/overwatch-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1064-06&utm_id=P1064-06 

Overwatch’s next big story begins with the Reign of Talon. 

For the first time ever, five new Heroes join the roster all at once! Jet Pack Cat, Anran, Domina, Emre, and Mizuki bring new playstyles, new dynamics, and new voices into the fray to shake up the battlefield like never before. 

Choose your allegiance as Overwatch and Talon collide in a five-week faction war that’s shaped by how you play. Complete missions, uncover new lore, and earn exclusive cosmetics to rep your faction of choice. And don’t worry, you’ll be able to switch sides to see the story from both perspectives. 

With new Competitive updates, the arrival of Vendetta in Stadium, evolving gameplay mechanics, and loads of new cosmetics, Season 1 sets a new standard for how the story of Overwatch is told and how you play it.
title: Overwatch – Season 1: Conquest Official Trailer – Nintendo Switch
